# Candidate Lab records

All records here are `candidate-unadmitted`, have authority effect `none`, and name unassigned owner roles. Their field shapes follow current Lab Project, Goal, Research Inquiry and Experiment Design examples. They are authoring inputs, not applied Project State or executed experiments.

| Model ID | Record |
| --- | --- |
| `project:ea-research-001` | [project-identity.json](project-identity.json) |
| `EA-G01` to `EA-G06` | [goal-01.json](goal-01.json), [goal-02.json](goal-02.json), [goal-03.json](goal-03.json), [goal-04.json](goal-04.json), [goal-05.json](goal-05.json), [goal-06.json](goal-06.json) |
| `EA-RQ-03` central strong thesis | [research-inquiry.json](research-inquiry.json) |
| `EA-E06` prospective comparison | [experiment-design.json](experiment-design.json) |

E01-E05 and E07-E08 are bounded designs in [EXPERIMENTS.md](../EXPERIMENTS.md). They need selected role, source, owner and participant decisions before promotion to executable Lab records. No run or finding is claimed.
